IITs and IIEST Sign MoUs for Research and AI Centers

Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kharagpur has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with TCG CREST to enhance research, innovation, and education. Separately, the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology (IIEST) Shibpur has entered into an MoU with TCS to establish an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Centre of Excellence on its campus. This initiative aims to bolster India's AI ecosystem.
